services.name: Botox

services.name: Botox at home
services.story: The main story: Botox at Alex's home, after Leo's video exam and Sam's OK. Priced by Ethan at the visit, by area and units: $245 in the example. The $89 house call is paid now as the deposit and counts toward the price; Rosie texts the bill for the $156 rest when Ethan texts DONE.

services.name: Botox at home
services.story: The same home visit, where the saved card is charged for the rest when Ethan texts DONE, after Alex's yes to the price.

services_shape: treatments priced by the session from the list, or set at the visit by the amount used (units of a wrinkle relaxer, syringes of filler); a new client's first injection or laser visit starts with a prescriber's exam, right before the treatment or by video the day before
questions_before_times: new or returning client (a new client's first injection or laser visit adds the 15-minute exam)
which treatment, by its general name only
for laser: which area, since it sets the length
for a video exam: the state the client will be in
safety_stop: vision changes or loss, or skin turning white, gray or blue, after a filler
trouble breathing or swallowing, or swelling of the face, lips, tongue or throat
weakness that spreads, a drooping face, or trouble speaking after a wrinkle relaxer
chest pain, fainting, or a burn after laser that is large, blistering or spreading
first_steps: The good-faith exam by a prescriber
A written price estimate for self-pay clients
The medical director's OK for a home visit
license: always: each prescriber (a physician, nurse practitioner or physician assistant) and each nurse injector holds their own active license from the state where the client is during the visit, video exams included
staff_skills: the medical director (a physician): exams, orders, every treatment; nurse practitioners: exams, orders and injections where the state allows; nurse injectors: injections and laser on a prescriber's order, where the state allows; estheticians: skin care only, and microneedling only where the state's form allows; medical assistants and the front desk: no clinical work or OKs
messages_never: texts carry only the med spa's name, the date, the time, the address, the provider's first name and a secure link: never the treatment, units, the reason, health details, medicine names, photos or results
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
